audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 fits: LeBlanc owns lanes 1-6 with poke-and-dash-out, Veigar takes over from first item (Zhonya's) and hard-wins at two-plus. WR 51.52 over 1477 games supports it.
Spikes present and grounded: her 3-5 Q-W poke and E root-burst, her level 6 R-clone one-shot, Veigar first-item Zhonya's turn, Veigar late outright. All four content spikes exist.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full chart rows 4-6 said 'Skill' while content win[] and packet say LeBlanc at 6 and Veigar at first item and 2+ items; breakdown.cooldowns had no digit; enemyWin templated; Mirror Image decoy (her 40% passive) unmentioned anywhere on the page; 17 misgender hits; two copy-paste-bleed bullets.
audit.why: Distortion is 15s rank 1 with a 4s return window; Ethereal Chains is 14s with a 1.5s tether-to-root; below 40% health Mirror Image makes her invisible for 1s and spawns a no-damage decoy — that is the exact moment a targeted Primordial Burst gets confused, so R before the threshold.
